request.prompt:
Use the reference image as the exact first frame. Preserve the same two people, faces, hair, ages, wardrobe, apartment, lighting, and framing.
Scene: Elena and Andrey are in a beautiful modern apartment. They stand beside each other, physically close but emotionally distant. Elena looks into Andrey's eyes, waiting for a response. Andrey meets her gaze for a brief moment, then slowly looks away. Elena notices and becomes still. The meaning is emotional rejection without a single word.
Motion, once, at natural human speed: natural breathing; eye movement; one small turn of Andrey's head as he looks away; an almost imperceptible tightening in Elena's face.
No hand movement. No walking. No interaction with objects. No extra gestures. No camera movement, zoom, or pan. No change of lighting. No extra people. No speaking, no lip movement, no audio, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logo, no watermark.
Duration: 5 seconds.

estimate.pricing_description: For 16:9 video without video input, your request costs roughly $0.2056 per second of generated video at 480p, $0.4622 at 720p, and $1.1372 at 1080p. Each 1,000 video tokens costs $0.0214 at 480p or 720p and $0.0234 at 1080p. Billable video tokens = ceil(output height × output width × (input video duration + generated video duration) × 24 / 1024). Image and audio references do not count as video input. Actual pricing depends on output dimensions and billable duration. Rates shown are before any applicable customer discount.
